info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Magenta Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Magenta Drill Detail Management API facilitates the creation of detailed entries for magenta drill products within the catalog. This endpoint is designed for users looking to register new drill specifications, enhancing the overall product data available for marketing and sales initiatives. Developers integrating with this API can expect to streamline product management workflows, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information in their systems. Typical consumers include catalog managers and inventory systems aiming to maintain comprehensive and organized product details.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information for the Magenta Drill. It facilitates the addition of specific attributes and characteristics necessary for the management of Magenta drills.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for the magenta drill operation. Ensure that all required fields are included so that the operation can be processed successfully.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.
